study_design: Prospective cohort study with a case-cohort analysis
reason: The abstract evaluates incident prostate carcinoma overall. It does not report an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, high-risk, or lethal incident endpoint. Although the source cohort included 58,279 men, the analytic case-cohort sample comprised cases and subcohort members with complete toenail selenium data, and its unique total cannot be determined without inferring overlap.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: After 6.3 years of follow-up, 540 incident prostate carcinoma cases and 1,211 subcohort members with complete toenail selenium data were available for case-cohort analyses.
estimate_classifications.reason: The selenium estimate concerns overall incident prostate carcinoma and has no aggressive-disease restriction.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
